formId.title: Form Id
formId.description: Id of the form to change

targetField.title: Target
targetField.description: Field label or key, or page title or page number, that the rule applies to

ruleAction.title: Rule Action
ruleAction.description: show, hide or require. Pages support show and hide.

whenField.title: When Field
whenField.description: Field whose answer is checked, by label or key, or a table row or a name or address part by its key from the outline, for example satisfaction.price, name.lastName or address.country (an address's country and state are tested by name, such as Australia)

operator.title: Operator
operator.description: equals, not equals, contains, is empty, is not empty, greater than or less than. Defaults to equals.

value.title: Value
value.description: Answer to compare with. Not needed for is empty or is not empty.

combine.title: Combine With Existing
combine.description: and or or, to add this condition to an existing rule with the same action. Leave empty to replace it.
